Microsoft.title: Scaling AI value without losing control: Lessons from Frontier Firms - The Official Microsoft Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: Scaling AI value without losing control: Lessons from Frontier Firms - The Official Microsoft Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: 통제력을 잃지 않고 AI 가치 확장 · 개척 기업의 교훈 - 공식 Microsoft 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
Black & Veatch reached 98% adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot through deliberate change management, including early-adopter cohorts that surfaced real business use cases.
The clearest lessons come from Frontier Firms, the group last year’s research introduced: the top 10% of organizations on IDC’s AI maturity scale.
The lesson from Frontier Firms is one I believe every leader can act on: scaling AI value means managing models, agents, governance and measurement as one accountable system.

Microsoft.title: Arm AppReady for Windows gives developers a faster path to native Windows on Arm applications
Microsoft.titleEn: Arm AppReady for Windows gives developers a faster path to native Windows on Arm applications
Microsoft.titleKo: Windows용 Arm AppReady는 개발자에게 Arm 애플리케이션의 기본 Windows에 대한 더 빠른 경로를 제공함
Microsoft.summary:
The next wave of applications will define the Windows on Arm experience As Arm-powered Windows devices reach more users, the value of the experience will show up in the software – how quickly a creative app makes content available, how smoothly a security product operates in the background, how efficiently a development environment handles local workloads, or how responsive and reliably an AI-enabled application runs without excessive power consumption.
The Windows on Arm ecosystem continues to expand, driven by growing OEM adoption and rising user demand for lightweight, power efficient, responsive, and AI-enabled PCs and laptops, as well as increasing investment from software vendors in building native Arm versions of their applications.
Check whether key dependencies have Windows on Arm-native versions; Review build systems, compiler settings, installers, and plug-ins; Identify architecture-specific code and performance-critical paths; Find Arm and Microsoft guidance for native Windows on Arm development; Explore AI-enabled tools and practices that can help scan code, identify portability issues, and speed up porting tasks.
summaryLinesEn: The next wave of applications will define the Windows on Arm experience As Arm-powered Windows devices reach more users, the value of the experience will show up in the software – how quickly a creative app makes content available, how smoothly a security product operates in the background, how efficiently a development environment handles local workloads, or how responsive and reliably an AI-enabled application runs without excessive power consumption.

The Windows on Arm ecosystem continues to expand, driven by growing OEM adoption and rising user demand for lightweight, power efficient, responsive, and AI-enabled PCs and laptops, as well as increasing investment from software vendors in building native Arm versions of their applications.

Check whether key dependencies have Windows on Arm-native versions; Review build systems, compiler settings, installers, and plug-ins; Identify architecture-specific code and performance-critical paths; Find Arm and Microsoft guidance for native Windows on Arm development; Explore AI-enabled tools and practices that can help scan code, identify portability issues, and speed up porting tasks.
summaryLinesKo: 차세대 애플리케이션은 Windows on Arm 경험을 정의할 것임 · Arm 기반 Windows 장치가 더 많은 사용자에게 도달함에 따라 경험의 가치는 소프트웨어에 나타날 것임 · 즉, 창의적인 앱이 콘텐츠를 얼마나 빨리 제공하는지, 보안 제품이 백그라운드에서 얼마나 원활하게 작동하는지, 개발 환경이 로컬 워크로드를 얼마나 효율적으로 처리하는지, AI 지원 애플리케이션이 과도한 전력 소비 없이 얼마나 반응적이고 안정적으로 실행되는지 등이 여기에 해당됨
Windows on Arm 에코시스템은 OEM 채택 증가와 경량, 전력 효율성, 반응성이 뛰어난 AI 지원 PC 및 노트북에 대한 사용자 수요 증가, 애플리케이션의 기본 Arm 버전 구축에 대한 소프트웨어 공급업체의 투자 증가로 인해 지속적으로 확장되고 있음

주요 종속성에 Arm 네이티브 버전의 Windows가 있는지 확인하세요 · 빌드 시스템, 컴파일러 설정, 설치 프로그램 및 플러그인을 검토함 · 아키텍처별 코드와 성능에 중요한 경로를 식별함 · 기본 Windows on Arm 개발에 대한 Arm 및 Microsoft 지침을 찾아보세요 · 코드를 스캔하고, 이식성 문제를 식별하고, 이식 작업 속도를 높이는 데 도움이 되는 AI 지원 도구와 사례를 살펴보세요

Microsoft.title: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot으로 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 가져오세요 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.
That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.

That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.
summaryLinesKo: Frontier 에이전트는 이제 Genie 온톨로지를 활용하여 비즈니스를 해석하는 데 필요한 정의, 관계 및 소스 컨텍스트를 제공할 수 있음
이것이 바로 우리가 관리되는 정의와 지속적으로 학습된 조직 지식을 결합하여 AI 에이전트에게 신뢰할 수 있는 통찰력을 제공하는 데 필요한 비즈니스 이해를 제공하는 엔터프라이즈 컨텍스트 계층인 Genie Ontology를 발표한 이유임

Microsoft.title: GitHub - wangzan101/Mika: An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.
Microsoft.titleEn: GitHub - wangzan101/Mika: An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.
Microsoft.summary:
Send this to the AI agent on it and it will set everything up for you: Follow https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/blob/main/docs/install-with-agent.en.md to install Mika on the Android phone connected over USB.
Run Settings › Recovery & repair › Compatibility self-check : 12 checks in about a minute, and you can send us the results in one tap.
Docs : all docs and a suggested reading order are in the docs index Community : join the X group chat ; to reach the author on WeChat, scan the QR code in the app under About › Contact the author (mention Mika in your request) Report a problem : open an issue ; About › Send feedback in the app can attach diagnostics Contribute : add usage knowledge for an app or website (plain text, no code needed), or contribute code; see the contributing guide

NVIDIA.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China's most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
NVIDIA.titleEn: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China's most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
NVIDIA.titleKo: 수출이 금지된 Nvidia 칩은 중국의 가장 강력한 AI 모델 뒤에 있음 · 아, Jensen
NVIDIA.summary:
Epoch AI, a nonprofit research organization, estimates that about two million advanced chips entered China in 2024 and 2025 through schemes designed to hide their final destination.
In May, the short-selling research firm Culper published a report arguing that Nvidia had a “ China problem ” because a significant share of its revenue was driven by Chinese demand, either through remote data centers or smuggling in violation of U.S. law.
Epoch’s data estimates that 275,000 Nvidia AI accelerators were imported to Malaysia in 2024 and 2025.
summaryLinesEn: Epoch AI, a nonprofit research organization, estimates that about two million advanced chips entered China in 2024 and 2025 through schemes designed to hide their final destination.

In May, the short-selling research firm Culper published a report arguing that Nvidia had a “ China problem ” because a significant share of its revenue was driven by Chinese demand, either through remote data centers or smuggling in violation of U.S. law.
Epoch’s data estimates that 275,000 Nvidia AI accelerators were imported to Malaysia in 2024 and 2025.
summaryLinesKo: 비영리 연구 기관인 Epoch AI는 최종 목적지를 숨기려는 계획을 통해 2024년과 2025년에 약 200만 개의 첨단 칩이 중국에 유입된 것으로 추정함
지난 5월, 공매도 조사 회사인 컬퍼(Culper)는 엔비디아가 원격 데이터 센터를 통하거나 미국 법을 위반하여 밀수입하는 등 중국 수요에 의해 수익의 상당 부분을 차지했기 때문에 엔비디아가 "중국 문제"를 안고 있다고 주장하는 보고서를 발표함
Epoch의 데이터에 따르면 2024년과 2025년에 275,000개의 Nvidia AI 가속기가 말레이시아로 수입된 것으로 추정됨

NVIDIA.summary:
The Shanghai AI facility where the smuggled NVIDIA units were installed is called the Yangtze River Delta Project, which Bloomberg says also has ties to Alice Huang.
Its president is Kang Wei, who is being reported as Alice's husband and the person who introduced her to Jensen Huang .
Former NVIDIA-CEO Jensen Huang is due to testify before Congress this month , and it's likely all of this information will be pored over by officials in the run-up to the event.

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA, OpenShell 기부 및 새로운 AI 인프라를 통해 오픈 소스 지원 확대
NVIDIA.summary:
Three new open source projects extend the DSX AI Factory Platform to make Kubernetes easier to run and inference faster to scale.
NVIDIA’s contribution of OpenShell to CNCF puts security infrastructure for autonomous agents in the community’s hands to build, inspect and improve — accelerating development and hardening its safeguards.
To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities.
summaryLinesEn: Three new open source projects extend the DSX AI Factory Platform to make Kubernetes easier to run and inference faster to scale.

To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities.
summaryLinesKo: 세 가지 새로운 오픈 소스 프로젝트는 DSX AI Factory 플랫폼을 확장하여 Kubernetes를 더 쉽게 실행하고 추론을 더 빠르게 확장할 수 있도록 함
CNCF에 대한 NVIDIA의 OpenShell 기여는 자율 에이전트를 위한 보안 인프라를 커뮤니티의 손에 맡겨 구축, 검사 및 개선함으로써 개발을 가속화하고 보호 장치를 강화함
이를 충족하기 위해 NVIDIA는 Kubernetes 및 클라우드 네이티브 커뮤니티를 위한 대표 컨퍼런스인 KubeCon + CloudNativeCon에서 오픈 소스에 대한 헌신을 심화하고 있음

NVIDIA.title: Arm and NVIDIA: Building the trusted compute foundation for the agentic AI era
NVIDIA.titleEn: Arm and NVIDIA: Building the trusted compute foundation for the agentic AI era
NVIDIA.titleKo: Arm과 NVIDIA: 에이전트 AI 시대를 위한 신뢰할 수 있는 컴퓨팅 기반 구축
NVIDIA.summary:
Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.
Arm technology is deployed across every major hyperscaler, and Arm-based rack-scale servers have now overtaken x86 as the dominant platform for accelerated computing, according to IDC .
Agentic infrastructure also needs independent compute that can observe, isolate and govern policies outside the environment where the agent itself is running.
summaryLinesEn: Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.
Arm technology is deployed across every major hyperscaler, and Arm-based rack-scale servers have now overtaken x86 as the dominant platform for accelerated computing, according to IDC .
Agentic infrastructure also needs independent compute that can observe, isolate and govern policies outside the environment where the agent itself is running.
summaryLinesKo: Arm의 Jeff DeFilippi는 @TheNextPlatform과 대화를 통해 에이전트 AI 워크로드용 인프라를 평가할 때 대기 시간, 동시성 및 랙당 완료된 작업이 중요한 이유를 공유함
IDC에 따르면 Arm 기술은 모든 주요 하이퍼스케일러에 배포되었으며 Arm 기반 랙 규모 서버는 이제 x86을 가속 컴퓨팅의 주요 플랫폼으로 추월함
또한 에이전트 인프라에는 에이전트 자체가 실행되는 환경 외부의 정책을 관찰, 격리 및 관리할 수 있는 독립적인 컴퓨팅이 필요함

Apple.summary:
The next time you connect your phone to your car, tap the Gemini icon on your CarPlay display, then start a new conversation or pick up a recent one.

Google DeepMind.title: PARDIG & SatWeave: Foundational Datasets for Earth Science
Google DeepMind.titleEn: PARDIG & SatWeave: Foundational Datasets for Earth Science
Google DeepMind.titleKo: PARDIG 및 SatWeave: 지구 과학을 위한 기초 데이터세트
Google DeepMind.summary:
PARDIG outperforms leading global baselines across all analyzed rain rates, including NASA’s IMERG-Final, a research-quality dataset of precipitation estimates that is incredibly important for countless applications.
Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.
Because PARDIG learns directly from satellites rather than relying solely on ground-based measurements, we expect it to have reliable accuracy everywhere on Earth, even in areas where these measurements are not available.

Because PARDIG learns directly from satellites rather than relying solely on ground-based measurements, we expect it to have reliable accuracy everywhere on Earth, even in areas where these measurements are not available.
summaryLinesKo: PARDIG는 수많은 응용 분야에서 매우 중요한 강수량 추정치에 대한 연구 품질 데이터 세트인 NASA의 IMERG-Final을 포함하여 분석된 모든 강수량에 걸쳐 주요 글로벌 기준선보다 성능이 뛰어남
오늘 우리는 기상, 수문학 및 기후 애플리케이션 구축에 있어 글로벌 커뮤니티를 지원하기 위해 SatWeave와 PARDIG라는 두 가지 기본 데이터 세트를 출시함

sourceLines: PARDIG outperforms leading global baselines across all analyzed rain rates, including NASA’s IMERG-Final, a research-quality dataset of precipitation estimates that is incredibly important for countless applications.
Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.

Because PARDIG learns directly from satellites rather than relying solely on ground-based measurements, we expect it to have reliable accuracy everywhere on Earth, even in areas where these measurements are not available.

Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen outscores the bigger Argon just four weeks after its launch
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google의 Gemini 4 Hydrogen은 출시 4주 만에 더 큰 Argon을 능가함
Google DeepMind.summary:
According to Google, Hydrogen beats the larger Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at the default "high" thinking level (51 vs. 50) and reaches up to 54 at the highest level, "xhigh."
For multimodal knowledge work like summarizing large PDFs, spreadsheets, or videos, Hydrogen supports up to one million output tokens on top of its one-million-token input window.
Google says it takes first place on the Vals Tax Agent Bench with 52.3 percent and ties for first on the Vals Legal Research Bench with 55.8 percent.

Google DeepMind.title: Google Deepmind shifts genomics AI from bulk tissue predictions to single cell type resolution with AlphaGenome 2
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google Deepmind shifts genomics AI from bulk tissue predictions to single cell type resolution with AlphaGenome 2
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google Deepmind는 AlphaGenome 2를 통해 유전체학 AI를 대량 조직 예측에서 단일 세포 유형 분해능으로 전환함
Google DeepMind.summary:
AlphaGenome 2 pinpoints disease genes and vaccine responses more accurately On the TenK10K benchmark dataset with 28 primary immune cell types, AlphaGenome 2 identified about 30 percent of causal variants.
Google Deepmind has introduced AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that predicts gene changes in specific human cell types.
It was trained on more than 107 million individual cell profiles from 68 tissues, according to Google Deepmind , and is meant to help researchers uncover the cellular drivers of disease.

Google DeepMind.title: We’re introducing a new transparency tool for invalid traffic in Google Ads.
Google DeepMind.titleEn: We’re introducing a new transparency tool for invalid traffic in Google Ads.
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google Ads에는 무효 트래픽에 대한 새로운 투명성 도구가 도입됨
Google DeepMind.summary:
So far in 2026, we’ve reduced advertiser exposure to invalid leads by an average of 30% through continuous system upgrades.
Today, we’re rolling out the Invalid Traffic Overview Card in Google Ads to give advertisers front-end transparency into how we protect their campaigns.
We’ve long built defenses directly into our ad systems to block invalid traffic, helping businesses get the most out of their budgets and spend with confidence.

Amazon.summary:
A SageMaker HyperPod cluster orchestrated by Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), with the inference operator installed ( Setting up your HyperPod clusters for model deployment ) and the training operator EKS add-on amazon-sagemaker-hyperpod-training-operator installed ( Installing the training operator ).
Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now provides Data Capture, a built-in capability that records live inference inputs and outputs to Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) at three independent tiers, with minimal latency impact and zero impact on model availability.
Guided decoding means it can only return a valid object with one of those labels: After the model was deployed, the retailer launched its own line of air conditioners, the Arctis series (Arctis 9K, 12K, Mini, and so on).

Amazon.summary:
AssemblyAI’s inference platform runs on Amazon ECS with compute capacity managed through ECS capacity providers.
To reduce recovery time, AssemblyAI creates custom Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) containing model artifacts and container images in approximately 2 minutes.
By running Amazon EC2 Spot Instances with GPUs in production, AssemblyAI achieved 70 percent cost savings on inference compute compared to On-Demand pricing.

Anthropic.title: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
Anthropic.titleEn: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
Anthropic.titleKo: Anthropic의 Claude for Manufacturing은 AI를 공장 소프트웨어에 직접 연결하여 산업 워크플로를 자동화함
Anthropic.summary:
This cuts setup time from weeks or months to hours or minutes but still requires human oversight due to the AI's limited grasp of physical processes.
Anthropic has released Claude for Manufacturing, a plugin giving the AI direct access to industrial software to automate factory workflows.
For that, Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard as a research preview, connecting AI agents to devices like robotic arms and microscopes via standardized drivers.

Anthropic.title: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
Anthropic.titleEn: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
Anthropic.titleKo: Claude의 Duet 에이전트는 약간 신경질적이고 놀라울 정도로 도움이 됨
Anthropic.summary:
I’ll type up my own little blogs, thank you very much Claude.
I wonder if it would change how I work if I knew I didn’t really need to take responsibility for putting things on my calendar, writing down a to-do list, or paying attention in a meeting because Duet will just handle it.
Normally, the products I test don’t offer to help me write up my experience with them.

Anthropic.title: Detecting and countering malicious uses of Claude
Anthropic.titleEn: Detecting and countering malicious uses of Claude
Anthropic.titleKo: 클로드의 악의적 이용 감지 및 대응
Anthropic.summary:
What is especially novel is that this operation used Claude not just for content generation, but also to decide when social media bot accounts would comment, like, or re-share posts from authentic social media users.
By sharing these insights, we hope to protect the safety of our users, prevent abuse or misuse of our services, enforce our Usage Policy and other terms, and share our learnings for the benefit of the wider online ecosystem.
Most significantly, the operation utilized Claude to make tactical engagement decisions such as determining whether social media bot accounts should like, share, comment on, or ignore specific posts created by other accounts based on political objectives aligned with their clients' interests.

Anthropic.title: How Claude Code is used in practice
Anthropic.titleEn: How Claude Code is used in practice
Anthropic.summary:
The share of GitHub projects with coding agent activity has more than doubled since late 2025, 1 and Claude Code users now spend an average of 20 hours per week using the tool.
Over the seven months we observe, the share of sessions spent debugging fell by nearly half, and usage shifted toward more end-to-end agentic use: deploying and running code, analyzing data, and writing non-code documents.
And what will rapid adoption and improvement of these tools mean for knowledge work broadly?

Anthropic.title: What 81,000 people told us about AI economics
Anthropic.titleEn: What 81,000 people told us about AI economics
Anthropic.titleKo: 81,000명의 사람들이 AI 경제학에 관해 우리에게 말한 것
Anthropic.summary:
In order to inform the public about the economic changes we’re observing with AI, our Economic Index shares what work Claude is being asked to do, and in which jobs Claude is doing the largest share of tasks.
Our recent survey of 81,000 Claude users shows that people who work in roles that are more exposed to AI have more concerns about AI-driven job displacement.
In contrast, some users sped up tasks they were already doing, like the accountant who said, “I built a tool that helps me finish a financing task in 15 minutes that used to take 2 hours.”

Anthropic.title: Measuring AI agent autonomy in practice
Anthropic.titleEn: Measuring AI agent autonomy in practice
Anthropic.summary:
One of the most widely cited capability assessments is METR’s “Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks,” which estimates that Claude Opus 4.5 can complete tasks with a 50% success rate that would take a human nearly 5 hours .
Second, as users returned from the holiday break, the projects they brought to Claude Code may have shifted from hobby projects to more tightly circumscribed work tasks.
It’s also important to note that Claude Code’s default settings require users to manually approve each action, so part of this transition may reflect users configuring the product to match their preferences for greater independence as they become familiar with Claude’s capabilities.

Follow Follow See All AI OpenAI says ChatGPT Wallet won’t share your actual credit card info with its AI agents.
OpenAI says that in order for agents to use ChatGPT Wallet, “websites need to ensure agents are not inadvertently blocked, and payment and risk systems need to recognize legitimate purchases made by agents.”

OpenAI.summary:
For instance, a management consultant could ask ChatGPT to pinpoint the exact time when a project’s scope changed by looking at more than six month’s worth of calls and meetings, and it will surface the exact moment when that occurred.
It’s this shortcoming that a startup called Clipto Inc. is trying to solve with the launch of a new AI chatbot memory platform called Clipto Studio, which enables AI assistants to listen in on calls, presentations and meetings and search through them or analyze them upon request.
We’re building the technology to make video and audio as accessible and as useful to AI as text, opening up an entirely new generation of applications.”

OpenAI.summary:
Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.
That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.

summaryLinesKo: Frontier 에이전트는 이제 Genie 온톨로지를 활용하여 비즈니스를 해석하는 데 필요한 정의, 관계 및 소스 컨텍스트를 제공할 수 있음
이것이 바로 우리가 관리되는 정의와 지속적으로 학습된 조직 지식을 결합하여 AI 에이전트에게 신뢰할 수 있는 통찰력을 제공하는 데 필요한 비즈니스 이해를 제공하는 엔터프라이즈 컨텍스트 계층인 Genie Ontology를 발표한 이유임

sourceLines: Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.

That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.

Databricks.title: How Block powers collaborative AI agents with Buzz and Unity Gateway | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: How Block powers collaborative AI agents with Buzz and Unity Gateway | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Block이 Buzz 및 Unity Gateway를 통해 협업 AI 에이전트를 강화하는 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
As an open source project, Buzz is model-agnostic and can be self-hosted, meaning it can run privately on your own network or system, giving users flexibility in how they deploy and configure their agents.
With Databricks Unity Gateway, employees who use Buzz can access frontier and open-weight models, experiment with different agent harnesses, and find the right combination based on the efficiency frontier for each task.
At Block, Databricks Unity Gateway helps power the Buzz experience by providing access to a broad selection of frontier and open-weight models through a single integration.
summaryLinesEn: As an open source project, Buzz is model-agnostic and can be self-hosted, meaning it can run privately on your own network or system, giving users flexibility in how they deploy and configure their agents.

With Databricks Unity Gateway, employees who use Buzz can access frontier and open-weight models, experiment with different agent harnesses, and find the right combination based on the efficiency frontier for each task.
At Block, Databricks Unity Gateway helps power the Buzz experience by providing access to a broad selection of frontier and open-weight models through a single integration.
summaryLinesKo: 오픈 소스 프로젝트인 Buzz는 모델에 구애받지 않고 자체 호스팅이 가능함 · 즉, 자체 네트워크나 시스템에서 비공개로 실행될 수 있어 사용자가 에이전트를 배포하고 구성하는 방법에 유연성을 제공함
Buzz를 사용하는 직원은 Databricks Unity Gateway를 사용하여 프론티어 및 개방형 모델에 액세스하고, 다양한 에이전트 하네스를 실험하고, 각 작업의 효율성 프론티어를 기반으로 올바른 조합을 찾을 수 있음
Block에서 Databricks Unity Gateway는 단일 통합을 통해 다양한 프론티어 및 개방형 모델에 대한 액세스를 제공함으로써 Buzz 경험을 강화하는 데 도움을 줌

Databricks.title: Lakehouse//RT: Scale real-time analytics, not your bill | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Lakehouse//RT: Scale real-time analytics, not your bill | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Lakehouse//RT: 청구서가 아닌 실시간 분석 확장 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
And with growing demand for use cases like customer-facing dashboards that refresh in milliseconds and applications with embedded analytics, real-time workloads are quickly becoming a standard part of how businesses use data.
Lakehouse//RT is intentionally built to absorb that demand without a proportional cost increase Customers that chose Lakehouse//RT over separate real-time serving layers report 6x to 10x lower infrastructure costs AI agents are pushing the limits of data warehouses.
And even when a warehouse can deliver low latency, the bill grows as fast as demand: 10x the queries could easily mean 10x the cost.

summaryLinesKo: 그리고 밀리초 단위로 새로 고쳐지는 고객 대면 대시보드와 내장된 분석 기능이 있는 애플리케이션과 같은 사용 사례에 대한 수요가 증가함에 따라 실시간 워크로드는 기업에서 데이터를 사용하는 방식의 표준 부분으로 빠르게 자리잡고 있음
Lakehouse//RT는 비례적인 비용 증가 없이 해당 수요를 흡수하도록 의도적으로 구축됨 · 별도의 실시간 서비스 계층 대신 Lakehouse//RT를 선택한 고객은 인프라 비용이 6~10배 더 낮다고 보고함 · AI 에이전트는 데이터 웨어하우스의 한계를 뛰어넘고 있음
그리고 창고가 짧은 대기 시간을 제공할 수 있더라도 청구서는 수요만큼 빠르게 증가함 · 즉, 쿼리가 10배 증가하면 비용이 10배 증가할 수 있음

Databricks.titleEn: How H6.ai builds AI-powered financial automation with Lakebase Postgres | Databricks Blog

Databricks.summary:
Traditional accounts payable and invoice processing tools often force companies into a trade-off: moving quickly using AI automation and risk losing control, or maintaining tedious manual oversight.
H6.ai gives every customer a dedicated Lakebase Postgres database, which keeps each customer's financial data isolated on a multi-tenant AP automation platform.
It is how we build AI-powered financial automation that customers can trust.

H6.ai는 모든 고객에게 전용 Lakebase Postgres 데이터베이스를 제공하여 각 고객의 재무 데이터를 멀티 테넌트 AP 자동화 플랫폼에 격리시킴

Databricks.titleKo: Eclipse Aerospace는 Databricks를 사용하여 비행 데이터 수집을 단순화합니다 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Eclipse Aerospace relies on Databricks to store nearly 20 years of flight data, totalling more than 3TB.
It supports its service centers and engineers with data from more than a million flight hours, sourced and verified across multiple sources, including: near-real-time satellite telemetry; large bulk uploads of full flight histories; and external data sources.
For Eclipse Aerospace, a very light jet manufacturer and operator, partnering with Databricks offered a way to make nearly two decades of proprietary flight data more accessible to service centers and engineers without adding costly, always-on infrastructure.

For Eclipse Aerospace, a very light jet manufacturer and operator, partnering with Databricks offered a way to make nearly two decades of proprietary flight data more accessible to service centers and engineers without adding costly, always-on infrastructure.

Databricks.title: Dispelling LTAP myths | Databricks Blog
Databricks.summary:
Logical replication replays every change through a pipeline that must keep up, which makes it a costly way to build the lake copy.
That is why Postgres stays fast, analytics stays fresh, and no CDC pipeline is needed Lakebase's LTAP design makes the lake the database's storage, not a replica: one Delta or Iceberg table, one catalog, with Postgres caches and pageservers in front for speed.
Four readings came up often: “A single copy of the data can have only one physical layout, so either point lookups or scans must be slow” “Iceberg or Delta tables on object storage are inherently stale”
summaryLinesEn: Logical replication replays every change through a pipeline that must keep up, which makes it a costly way to build the lake copy.

That is why Postgres stays fast, analytics stays fresh, and no CDC pipeline is needed Lakebase's LTAP design makes the lake the database's storage, not a replica: one Delta or Iceberg table, one catalog, with Postgres caches and pageservers in front for speed.

Four readings came up often: “A single copy of the data can have only one physical layout, so either point lookups or scans must be slow” “Iceberg or Delta tables on object storage are inherently stale”
summaryLinesKo: 논리적 복제는 유지되어야 하는 파이프라인을 통해 모든 변경 사항을 재생하므로 레이크 복사본을 구축하는 데 비용이 많이 듬
이것이 바로 Postgres가 빠른 속도를 유지하고 분석이 최신 상태를 유지하며 CDC 파이프라인이 필요하지 않은 이유임 · Lakebase의 LTAP 설계는 호수를 복제본이 아닌 데이터베이스의 스토리지로 만듬 · 하나의 Delta 또는 Iceberg 테이블, 하나의 카탈로그, 속도를 위해 Postgres 캐시와 페이지 서버가 앞에 있음
4가지 판독값이 자주 나왔음 · "데이터의 단일 복사본에는 하나의 물리적 레이아웃만 있을 수 있으므로 포인트 조회나 스캔이 느려야 함" · "객체 스토리지의 Iceberg 또는 Delta 테이블은 본질적으로 오래됨"

Sierra AI.title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.summary:
Personal Agent Protocol gives them that foundation — so the company and the personal agent can get the job done for the customer they share.
When a task requires access to a customer’s account, they can sign in on the company’s page or use credentials they have already set up with their personal agent.
Update: On 10/9, we shared a draft of Personal Agent Protocol, with 35 new design partners including Bank of America, OpenAI, Visa, and United Airlines.

Sierra AI.title: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.titleEn: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.summary:
Replies can stream as they’re written, and companies can hold a request open until there’s news to share.
Businesses have no standard way to help guide the agent, which limits what the customer, their personal agent and the brand can do directly together.
So today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol , known as Poppy, and announcing an additional 35 design partners: Adyen, Atomic, Bank of America, BBVA, Chime, Cigna, Cloudflare, Comcast, DIRECTV, ElevenLabs, FOX, Gap Inc., GEICO, Hertz, Insurify, Klaviyo, Liberty Mutual, Mastercard, Nordstrom, Notion, Okta, OneSignal, OpenAI, PayPal, Plaid, SiriusXM, Synchrony, Target, United Airlines, Venmo, Visa, Wells Fargo, Zapier, Zendesk, and 1Password.

Sierra AI.title: Releasing Personal Agent Protocol 1.0
Sierra AI.summary:
Mercury puts personal agents to work on finances: People who use Mercury for business and personal banking can now ask their personal agent to check balances, review recent transactions, categorize spending, or keep budgets and receipts up to date.
Made it easier for companies to adopt the protocol in stages, starting with the basics and adding capabilities over time; Expanded a company’s ability to provide guidance and collect feedback from the personal agent; Introduced extensions, such as the commerce extension co-authored by Shopify, so industries can build on the core protocol without changing it.
Sierra and Shopify bring Poppy to millions of merchants Shopify powers businesses in more than 175 countries, and every Shopify store supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) by default.

Made it easier for companies to adopt the protocol in stages, starting with the basics and adding capabilities over time; Expanded a company’s ability to provide guidance and collect feedback from the personal agent; Introduced extensions, such as the commerce extension co-authored by Shopify, so industries can build on the core protocol without changing it.
Sierra and Shopify bring Poppy to millions of merchants Shopify powers businesses in more than 175 countries, and every Shopify store supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) by default.

기업이 기본부터 시작하여 시간이 지남에 따라 기능을 추가하는 단계적으로 프로토콜을 채택하기가 더 쉬워졌음 · 개인 에이전트로부터 지침을 제공하고 피드백을 수집하는 회사의 능력을 확대함 · Shopify가 공동으로 작성한 상거래 확장과 같은 확장 기능을 도입하여 업계에서는 핵심 프로토콜을 변경하지 않고도 핵심 프로토콜을 기반으로 구축할 수 있음

Sierra AI.title: Meet Mossy: designing a voice you can see
Sierra AI.titleEn: Meet Mossy: designing a voice you can see
Sierra AI.titleKo: Mossy를 만나보세요 · 볼 수 있는 목소리 디자인하기
Sierra AI.summary:
This year at Sierra I worked on a similar project: designing how to visually represent Sierra’s voice agents.
Whatever we created would appear throughout the event and needed to help people follow the conversation.
About a decade ago, I worked at a design studio with a team of 12 people on projects that typically took one to six months to complete.

Lovable.summary:
The service handles peaks of over 2 million concurrent subscriptions and delivers around 2.6 billion data and patch frames per month.
We needed the backend to decide what each user received and keep that decision up to date as both the data and their permissions changed.
When a NATS message arrives, the pod dispatches it to every matching subscription instance, which re-evaluates its data projection, deduplicates via xxh3-128 hash, and pushes the deltas to the frontend if the output changed.

Suno.summary:
It recently filed a lawsuit against Anthropic , claiming $41 million in damages for allegedly training its AI models on the musician's works without permission.
New lawsuits are claiming that Suno has once again committed copyright infringement by using Elvis Presley and Eminem's likeness to create AI-generated songs.
As first reported by Variety , a group that owns the rights to Presley's music and Eight Mile Style, a music publishing company that owns hundreds of Eminem recordings, filed separate lawsuits against Suno.

Hugging Face.summary:
On Stack Overflow, Sonnet 4.6’s rate of including a solution to the underlying goal rose from 59% to 67%, but its misconception-identification rate fell from 47% to 34%.
A more helpful answer would recognize that the user wants to restore suction and focus on diagnosing the cause.
Truly useful AI assistants need to be able to help users who ask misguided questions—not just users who ask the right question with the right amount of detail.

Hugging Face.summary:
Nvidia had announced its plan to acquire the platform for open source AI models in September for $12.9 billion, making it the second-largest acquisition in the company’s history, just behind that of chipmaker Groq’s assets for $20 billion in December 2025.
Last month, Nvidia expanded its Nemotron family of open-weight models with a large 120-billion-parameter model for agents used by the enterprise as well as with two new lightweight Bolt models that run on PCs.
Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty.… pic.twitter.com/t02bi51N4C In August, Nvidia also announced a $6 billion deal with the coding startup Poolside to help build out an open AI ecosystem in the U.S. to help the country compete against Chinese companies like DeepSeek and Kimi K3, The Wall Street Journal reported at the time.

Hugging Face.summary:
Token pooling-aware training raises that retention to 97.8% at the same storage budget!
At 4 bits per residual coordinate, 200 vectors of 128 dimensions require 12.8 KB of quantized residuals per document, or 12.8 GB across a million documents.
With MaxSim scoring, each query vector selects its best matching document vector, and those scores are added together: MaxSim ⁡ ( Q , D ) = ∑ q ∈ Q max ⁡ d ∈ D q ⊤ d \operatorname{MaxSim}(Q, D) = \sum_{q \in Q} \max_{d \in D} q^\top d MaxSim ( Q , D ) = q ∈ Q ∑ ​ d ∈ D max ​ q ⊤ d Even with the 2-bit or 4-bit residual quantization supported by Fast-PLAID , storing hundreds of vectors per document adds up.
summaryLinesEn: Token pooling-aware training raises that retention to 97.8% at the same storage budget!
At 4 bits per residual coordinate, 200 vectors of 128 dimensions require 12.8 KB of quantized residuals per document, or 12.8 GB across a million documents.

With MaxSim scoring, each query vector selects its best matching document vector, and those scores are added together: MaxSim ⁡ ( Q , D ) = ∑ q ∈ Q max ⁡ d ∈ D q ⊤ d \operatorname{MaxSim}(Q, D) = \sum_{q \in Q} \max_{d \in D} q^\top d MaxSim ( Q , D ) = q ∈ Q ∑ ​ d ∈ D max ​ q ⊤ d Even with the 2-bit or 4-bit residual quantization supported by Fast-PLAID , storing hundreds of vectors per document adds up.

Hugging Face.summary:
BotPsy achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) tool-use and agentic performance for its size, outperforming every model of up to 1.2B parameters that we tested (Figures 1 and 2).
As intelligence per parameter continues to improve rapidly, we aim to stand at the forefront of this shift toward performant, privacy-focused, self-hosted models.
Twice the performance of its base model: BotPsy roughly doubles the agentic capability of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Think on key benchmarks: BFCL v4 rises from 23.4 to 44.0, ACEBench from 30.1 to 58.7, and τ-bench from 23.2 to 51.5 (mean of the retail, telecom and banking subsets).

Writer.title: How life science businesses transform communications using enterprise generative AI
Writer.titleEn: How life science businesses transform communications using enterprise generative AI
Writer.titleKo: 생명과학 기업이 엔터프라이즈 생성 AI를 사용하여 커뮤니케이션을 혁신하는 방법
Writer.summary:
McKinsey reports that generative AI will propel $18-$30 billion in value annually through commercial life sciences (pharma) use cases like personalized content creation, medical and legal review assistance, customer enablement, strategic insights, and patient experience optimization.
With a generative AI platform, medical comms teams can reduce MLR review time from 30%-50%, increase first-pass MLR approvals by 20%-30%, and dramatically reduce the risk of fines and censure.
The same report predicts an additional $3 to $5 billion in annual value through efficiency gains in customer-insight generation, better-quality medical writing, and rapid summaries of scientific literature.
summaryLinesEn: McKinsey reports that generative AI will propel $18-$30 billion in value annually through commercial life sciences (pharma) use cases like personalized content creation, medical and legal review assistance, customer enablement, strategic insights, and patient experience optimization.
With a generative AI platform, medical comms teams can reduce MLR review time from 30%-50%, increase first-pass MLR approvals by 20%-30%, and dramatically reduce the risk of fines and censure.

The same report predicts an additional $3 to $5 billion in annual value through efficiency gains in customer-insight generation, better-quality medical writing, and rapid summaries of scientific literature.
summaryLinesKo: McKinsey는 생성 AI가 개인화된 콘텐츠 생성, 의료 및 법률 검토 지원, 고객 지원, 전략적 통찰력, 환자 경험 최적화와 같은 상업 생명과학(제약) 사용 사례를 통해 연간 180억~300억 달러의 가치를 창출할 것이라고 보고함
생성적 AI 플랫폼을 사용하면 의료 커뮤니케이션 팀은 MLR 검토 시간을 30%~50% 단축하고, 1차 통과 MLR 승인을 20%~30% 늘리며, 벌금과 비난의 위험을 획기적으로 줄일 수 있음
동일한 보고서에서는 고객 통찰력 생성, 더 나은 품질의 의학 문서 작성, 과학 문헌의 신속한 요약을 통한 효율성 향상을 통해 연간 가치가 30억~50억 달러 추가로 증가할 것으로 예측함

This shift has given us a new metric to track: share of model (SoM).
They won’t just catch up — they’ll help define what visibility means in the AI era.

Writer.title: Scientific credibility is irreplaceable. Are your medical writing systems protecting it?
Writer.titleEn: Scientific credibility is irreplaceable. Are your medical writing systems protecting it?
Writer.titleKo: 과학적 신뢰성은 무엇과도 바꿀 수 없음 · 귀하의 의료 기록 시스템이 이를 보호하고 있습니까
Writer.summary:
PubMed now indexes more than 1.56 million new citations a year , and scientific content is thought to be growing at roughly 5–6% annually .
While attitudes are beginning to shift toward human-in-the-loop approaches, relying on consumer-grade generative AI today can raise red flags during publication and peer review — exactly where credibility matters most.
But with more launches in narrower indications, tighter regulator and journal scrutiny, and stretched writing and review capacity, credibility can slip, not because the science is weak, but because the system can’t keep up.

But with more launches in narrower indications, tighter regulator and journal scrutiny, and stretched writing and review capacity, credibility can slip, not because the science is weak, but because the system can’t keep up.

인간 참여형(Human-In-The-Loop) 접근 방식으로 태도가 바뀌기 시작했지만 오늘날 소비자급 생성 AI에 의존하면 출판 및 동료 검토 과정에서 신뢰성이 가장 중요한 지점인 위험 신호를 제기할 수 있음
그러나 더 좁은 범위의 출시가 늘어나고, 규제 기관과 저널의 엄격한 조사, 집필 및 검토 역량의 확대로 인해 신뢰성이 떨어질 수 있음 · 이는 과학이 약하기 때문이 아니라 시스템이 따라잡을 수 없기 때문임

Writer.title: The part of healthcare's cost that payers can fix this year
Writer.titleEn: The part of healthcare's cost that payers can fix this year
Writer.titleKo: 올해 의료비 중 납부자가 고칠 수 있는 부분
Writer.summary:
Family coverage through an employer now costs an average of $28,303 a year [1], and employers expect costs to keep climbing — increases have ranged from 5% to 7% annually in recent years [2].
Plans, providers, and employers are all working to bend the cost curve, and it’s genuinely complex: misaligned incentives, fragmented data, years of accumulated process.
Health Affairs research brief, Oct. 2022: administration is 15% to 30% of spending; at least half is wasteful.

Meta AI.titleEn: Meta is expanding AI age detection for Instagram teen accounts - Engadget
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta, 인스타그램 청소년 계정에 대한 AI 연령 감지 확장 - Engadget
Meta AI.summary:
Update, November 9, 2026, 2:12PM ET: A previous version of this story indicated that Meta is using bone structure analysis of photos, as well as mentions of things like school grades or birthday celebrations to estimate a person's age.
If the systems determine the person is aged between 13 and 17, they'll be funneled into a teen account, even if they used an adult date of birth while signing up.
In August, the company reached an agreement (under which it may have to pay as much as $18 billion) with 52 attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that alleged harms to young users of its apps.

summaryLinesKo: 업데이트, 2026년 11월 9일 오후 2시 12분(ET): 이 이야기의 이전 버전에서는 Meta가 사진의 뼈 구조 분석을 사용하고 학교 성적이나 생일 축하와 같은 언급을 사용하여 사람의 나이를 추정하고 있음을 나타냄
시스템에서 해당 사용자가 13세에서 17세 사이라고 판단하면 가입 시 성인 생년월일을 사용했더라도 해당 사용자는 청소년 계정으로 분류됨
지난 8월, 회사는 자사 앱의 젊은 사용자들에게 해를 끼쳤다고 주장되는 소송을 해결하기 위해 52명의 법무장관과 합의(최대 180억 달러를 지불해야 할 수도 있음)에 도달함

Meta AI.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta는 에이전트가 실제로 수행하는 반복적인 작업을 위해 구축된 소형 AI 모델인 Muse Ember를 출시함
Meta AI.summary:
Muse Ember leads in most of Meta's own tests, but Haiku outperforms it on real coding tasks in FrontierCode 2.0-AA, scoring 34.9 percent to Muse Ember's 27.2 percent.
Meta has introduced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model to date.
It's available now through the Meta Model API and Muse Code at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.

Meta AI.title: Meta expands Instagram's AI age-guessing tech globally
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta expands Instagram's AI age-guessing tech globally
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta, Instagram의 AI 연령 추측 기술을 전 세계적으로 확장
Meta AI.summary:
The global expansion comes as Meta reached settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every U.S. state and territory in August to resolve lawsuits alleging its platforms harm teens.
Meta announced on Monday that it’s expanding its AI-powered age-estimation technology on Instagram worldwide to identify more teens and place them under its Teen Account protections, as it faces numerous lawsuits accusing its platforms of harming teens.
Meta said parents in the U.S. will start seeing an in-feed video on Instagram explaining its approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections.
summaryLinesEn: The global expansion comes as Meta reached settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every U.S. state and territory in August to resolve lawsuits alleging its platforms harm teens.

Meta announced on Monday that it’s expanding its AI-powered age-estimation technology on Instagram worldwide to identify more teens and place them under its Teen Account protections, as it faces numerous lawsuits accusing its platforms of harming teens.
Meta said parents in the U.S. will start seeing an in-feed video on Instagram explaining its approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections.
summaryLinesKo: 이러한 글로벌 확장은 Meta가 플랫폼이 청소년에게 해를 끼친다고 주장하는 소송을 해결하기 위해 지난 8월 미국의 거의 모든 주 및 준주와 최대 180억 달러 규모의 합의에 도달함에 따라 이루어졌음
메타(Meta)는 플랫폼이 십대들에게 해를 끼친다고 비난하는 수많은 소송에 직면함에 따라 더 많은 십대들을 식별하고 그들을 십대 계정 보호 하에 두기 위해 전 세계 인스타그램에서 AI 기반 연령 추정 기술을 확장한다고 월요일 발표함
Meta는 미국의 부모들이 10대 자녀가 연령에 적합한 보호를 받을 수 있도록 하는 접근 방식을 설명하는 Instagram의 인피드 비디오를 보게 될 것이라고 말함

Meta AI.summary:
Instagram says after an effect is approved, it “shows up in Instagram Stories for anyone to use, and whenever someone uses your effect we’ll link back to your profile so that it’s easy for others to find your work.”
Then you can upload your own photos to preview the AI-generating effects, and ask for changes in follow-up prompts.
Follow Follow See All Tech The Effect Builder bot is available on the web to build whatever new Instagram filters you can think of.

개요 소프트웨어 - 인프라/기술 MiniMax Group Inc.는 인공지능(AI) 기반 모델의 연구 및 개발에 참여하고 있음
